description: During scaffolding erection at the gas sweetening unit, two workers observed working at approximately 12 metres without fall arrest harnesses. Guardrails on the second tier were incomplete — only one side rail installed. Workers stated harnesses were available but uncomfortable in heat. Scaffold tag showed last inspection was overdue by 3 weeks.
barrier_failure: Incomplete guardrail installation and missing fall arrest
potential_consequence: Fall from height — serious injury / fatality

description: Temporary work platform on the wellhead deck lacked proper tie-offs and edge protection. Three riggers were working on the platform at 8 metres elevation. Safety nets below were not deployed. Observed during routine walkthrough.
barrier_failure: Missing edge protection and safety nets
potential_consequence: Fall from height — serious injury / fatality

description: A section of scaffold plank dislodged while workers were ascending to the top of a storage tank for painting. The plank fell 10 metres and struck the ground near a helper standing below. No injury occurred. Investigation revealed the planks were not secured with toe boards and the scaffold had not been inspected after recent high winds.
barrier_failure: Unsecured scaffold planks — no toe boards
potential_consequence: Struck by falling object — serious injury / fatality

description: Confined space entry into the amine absorber column for internal inspection. Gas test was performed 45 minutes prior to entry but not repeated at the point of entry as required. Rescue tripod was positioned but the rescue line was not connected to the entrant's harness. Standby person was present but untrained in rescue procedures.
activity_extracted: Confined space entry for vessel inspection
barrier_failure: Stale gas test and disconnected rescue line
potential_consequence: Toxic gas exposure in confined space — fatality

description: During entry into a ballast tank for corrosion survey, the entrant reported dizziness after 20 minutes. Immediate evacuation was performed. Subsequent gas test showed oxygen level had dropped to 18.5% (below 19.5% minimum). Initial gas test before entry had shown 20.8%. The ventilation fan had been switched off by another crew working nearby who needed the electrical outlet.
activity_extracted: Confined space entry for corrosion survey
barrier_failure: Ventilation interrupted — oxygen depletion
potential_consequence: Asphyxiation in confined space — fatality

description: Vessel entry permit for the crude oil storage tank was valid but the atmospheric monitoring readings had not been updated since the morning shift. The afternoon entry crew relied on 6-hour-old readings. Portable gas detector carried by the entrant was found to have an expired calibration sticker.
activity_extracted: Confined space entry for tank inspection
barrier_failure: Outdated gas readings and uncalibrated detector
potential_consequence: Toxic exposure in confined space — serious injury / fatality

description: During planned maintenance on the compressor unit, an electrician began work on a motor control centre that had not been isolated and locked out. The permit-to-work was issued for a different MCC panel. The electrician received a 415V shock but was wearing insulated gloves which prevented serious injury. Work was stopped immediately.
barrier_failure: Wrong panel isolated — permit mismatch
potential_consequence: Electrocution — fatality
evidence: LOTO not applied to correct panel

description: A pump motor was being repaired while the upstream isolation valve was closed but not locked. No lockout tag was visible. The electrician stated that verbal clearance had been given by the operator. No energy isolation certificate was found at the worksite. Two other workers were in the immediate area.
barrier_failure: No LOTO applied — verbal clearance only
potential_consequence: Unexpected energisation — electrocution / fatality

description: Isolation of the heat exchanger for tube bundle replacement was incomplete. One of three block valves had not been closed. The maintenance team started unbolting the flange before confirming zero energy state. Process fluid (hot naphtha, 85°C) began seeping through the partially open valve. Work stopped and area evacuated. No injuries.
barrier_failure: Incomplete isolation — block valve not closed
potential_consequence: Hydrocarbon release — fire / serious burns / fatality

description: Crane lifting a 4-tonne pipe spool on the production platform. The rigging crew used a single-leg sling instead of the required two-leg bridle sling for the load geometry. The spool was not tag-lined, and wind speed was reported at 28 knots — above the 25-knot operational limit. The lift proceeded despite the banksman raising a concern.
barrier_failure: Wrong sling configuration — exceeded wind limit
potential_consequence: Dropped object — struck-by — fatality

description: A 200kg beam clamp detached during a tandem lift at the well pad laydown area. The clamp fell 6 metres and landed approximately 1 metre from two helpers who were guiding the load. Preliminary investigation showed the clamp's load pin was worn beyond its replacement threshold. No exclusion zone had been established beneath the lift.
barrier_failure: Worn clamp pin — no exclusion zone
potential_consequence: Dropped object struck worker — serious injury / fatality

description: Mobile crane performing a routine lift near the sulphur recovery unit. The load chart was not consulted for the lift radius. Outrigger on the east side was not fully extended due to a drainage trench. The crane operator stated he estimated the load was within capacity. Rigger on the ground had no communication radio.
activity_extracted: Mobile crane lift near process unit
barrier_failure: No load chart — partial outrigger — no comms
potential_consequence: Crane tip-over or dropped load — fatality

description: Hot work (grinding) being performed on a pipeline flange within 5 metres of an open drain containing residual hydrocarbon. No hot work permit was displayed at the worksite. The fire watch was assigned but had left the area to collect additional fire extinguishers. Combustible gas indicator was not being used during the operation.
activity_extracted: Hot work grinding near hydrocarbon drain
barrier_failure: No permit displayed — fire watch absent — no CGI
potential_consequence: Fire / explosion — serious burns / fatality

description: Welding on a structural member above the cellar deck. Sparks dropped through an open grating onto a tarpaulin covering paint drums stored on the deck below. The tarpaulin began smouldering before the fire watch on the lower deck extinguished it. Investigation found the hot work permit specified spark containment blankets but none were deployed.
barrier_failure: Spark blankets not deployed — flammables below
potential_consequence: Fire involving flammable materials — fatality potential

description: Two contract workers observed cutting a redundant small-bore pipe using an oxy-acetylene torch in the pipe rack area. No hot work permit was in evidence. Area contained multiple live hydrocarbon lines. Workers stated they had received verbal approval from their supervisor. No fire extinguisher or fire blanket was present at the worksite.
barrier_failure: No permit — verbal approval — no fire protection
potential_consequence: Hydrocarbon fire in pipe rack — multiple fatalities

description: Tanker driver observed reversing a loaded crude tanker without a banksman in the well pad area at night. Reverse alarm was not functioning. Area lighting was inadequate — only one of three floodlights operational. Two pedestrian workers were in the reversing path and had to move quickly to avoid the vehicle.
activity_extracted: Tanker reversing at well pad — night
barrier_failure: No banksman — faulty reverse alarm — poor lighting
potential_consequence: Vehicle struck pedestrians — serious injury / fatality

description: A crew transport vehicle carrying 8 workers exceeded the site speed limit of 30 km/h, travelling at approximately 55 km/h on an unpaved access road to the drilling location. The vehicle skidded on a gravel patch and left the road but came to a stop before reaching a drainage ditch. No seatbelts were worn by passengers in the rear.
activity_extracted: Crew transport on unpaved access road
barrier_failure: Speeding — no seatbelts — unpaved road
potential_consequence: Vehicle rollover — multiple serious injuries / fatalities

description: Worker observed standing directly under a suspended load during a pipe rack construction lift. The crane operator could not see the worker due to a structural obstruction. No spotter or signalman was positioned to maintain the exclusion zone. The worker was retrieving a tool and was not aware the lift was in progress.
activity_extracted: Worker under suspended load during construction lift
barrier_failure: No exclusion zone — no spotter — blocked operator view
potential_consequence: Struck by falling load — fatality

description: Pressure test on a newly installed gas line. The test head assembly was pressurised to 150 bar. Workers were observed within 3 metres of the pressurised test head without blast shields. The test procedure specified a 10-metre exclusion radius during pressure hold. The area was not barricaded.
barrier_failure: Exclusion zone violated — no blast shields — no barricade
potential_consequence: High-pressure release — struck by projectile — fatality

description: Safety interlock on the high-pressure separator was found bypassed with a cable tie. The bypass was not documented in any permit or deviation log. Operations stated the interlock had been 'nuisance tripping' for two weeks. The instrument technician confirmed no work order had been raised to investigate the root cause of the trips.
activity_extracted: Process operations with bypassed safety interlock
barrier_failure: Safety interlock bypassed — undocumented
potential_consequence: Overpressure event — rupture — multiple fatalities

description: Work authorisation permit for the pipeline pigging operation had expired at 16:00 but work continued until 18:30. The permit issuer was not on site during the extension period. The control room was not informed that work was continuing beyond the permitted window. Gas testing had only been valid until the original permit end time.
barrier_failure: Expired permit — continued work — no revalidation
potential_consequence: Uncontrolled hydrocarbon release — fire — serious injury

description: Night shift operator found sleeping in the control room. The operator was the sole person monitoring the gas processing train. DCS alarm log showed 14 unacknowledged alarms during the period, including a high-level alarm on the glycol contactor. The alarm was later found to be a valid process deviation that self-corrected.
activity_extracted: Solo control room monitoring — night shift
barrier_failure: Operator incapacitated — alarms unacknowledged
potential_consequence: Undetected process upset — major release — multiple fatalities

description: During deck painting operations, a worker was using a wire brush to prepare a corroded railing at the edge of the production platform without wearing a safety harness. The work area was approximately 15 metres above sea level. No safety net was rigged. A second worker was holding the worker's belt — this was not an approved fall prevention method.
activity_extracted: Surface preparation at platform edge without harness
barrier_failure: No harness — no safety net — improvised restraint
potential_consequence: Fall from platform edge to sea — fatality

description: A contract worker suffered a hand laceration when a grinding disc shattered during pipe preparation work. Investigation revealed the disc was rated for 7,000 RPM but the grinder was running at 11,000 RPM. The worker was wearing leather gloves but no cut-resistant gloves as required by the task risk assessment. First aid administered on site.
barrier_failure: Wrong disc rating — incorrect PPE
potential_consequence: Disc fragment projectile — eye/face injury — serious injury
evidence: disc rated 7000 RPM on 11000 RPM tool

description: A forklift was observed carrying a load that obscured the driver's forward vision in the warehouse area. The driver was travelling forward instead of reversing as required when vision is blocked. Several pedestrian workers were in the aisle without high-visibility vests. Forklift horn was not used at the intersection.
barrier_failure: Obstructed vision — wrong travel direction — no horn
potential_consequence: Vehicle struck pedestrian — serious injury / fatality

description: H2S personal monitors were not being worn by three workers conducting a well intervention operation on a known sour well. The workers stated their monitors were sent for calibration and replacements had not been issued. The area H2S detector on the wellhead was functional but the wind sock indicated workers were downwind of the well.
activity_extracted: Well intervention on sour well without H2S monitors
barrier_failure: No personal H2S monitors — workers downwind
potential_consequence: H2S exposure — incapacitation — fatality
